format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <main>
<sf-language id="pair" languages="ru en" size="1/2" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="trio" languages="ru en pt-BR" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="two" languages="ru en" mode="inline" size="1/2"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="codes" languages="ru en de" mode="inline" labels="code" size="1/2" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="compact-alias" languages="ru en de" mode="inline" compact size="1/2" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="five" languages="ru en de fr es" size="1/2"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="twelve" languages="ru en de fr es it pt tr pl uk ja ar" size="1/2" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="rtl" languages="ru en ar"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="url" languages="ru en" href="#/{code}/" remember="probe"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="one" languages="ru"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="forced" languages="ru en de fr es" mode="inline" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="named" mode="inline" apply="none"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"code": "kk", "label": "Қазақ тілі"}, {"code": "ru"}]}</script></sf-language>
<form id="settings"><sf-language id="field" name="language" languages="ru en de fr" value="de" apply="none"></sf-language></form>
<sf-language id="missing" languages="ru en de" href="#/{code}/page/" missing="de" home="#/{code}/" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="variants" languages="ru pt-BR pt-PT zh-Hans zh-Hant" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="lone" languages="ru pt-BR" apply="none"></sf-language>
<form id="letter"><sf-language id="as-field" mode="field" name="letter" label="Язык письма" languages="ru en de" value="en" apply="none"></sf-language></form>
<sf-button id="app-trigger" text="Меню"></sf-button><sf-menu-context id="app" popup aria-label="Меню"></sf-menu-context>
</main>

probes.title: auto, owner decision C142: two and three languages are the button «RU ▾» -- the translate glyph, the current code, expand_more -- named «Язык: Русский», with a menu; no segmented track; the trigger keeps one width whatever language is chosen
probes.covers: settings.mode auto, look menu, settings.inline-max, accessibility trigger name, icon translate

steps.check: (() => { const ok = (el) => { const sb = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-button'); const button = sb && sb.querySelector('button'); const code = sb && sb.querySelector('.sf-language-code'); const shown = code && [...code.children].filter((span) => getComputedStyle(span).visibility === 'visible'); return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'menu' && el.look === 'menu' && !el.querySelector('sf-segmented') && sb.getAttribute('icon-start') === 'translate' && sb.getAttribute('icon-end') === 'expand_more' && button.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Язык: Русский' && button.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu' && shown.length === 1 && shown[0].textContent.trim() === 'RU'; }; return ok(document.querySelector('#pair')) && ok(document.querySelector('#trio')); })()

steps.script: (async () => { const el = document.querySelector('#trio'); const width = () => el.querySelector('sf-button button').getBoundingClientRect().width; const before = width(); el.select('pt-BR'); await el.whenRendered?.(null, {next: true}); await new Promise((done) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(done))); const after = width(); const button = el.querySelector('sf-button button'); const shown = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-language-code > span')].filter((span) => getComputedStyle(span).visibility === 'visible').map((span) => span.textContent.trim()).join(); el.select('ru'); return [Math.abs(before - after) < 0.5, button.getAttribute('aria-label'), shown].join('|'); })()

probes.title: mode="inline" (a settings page): two languages are a segmented switch named «Язык»: a radio per language, in its own name and its own lang, the page's language chosen
probes.covers: settings.languages, settings.mode inline, look inline, accessibility radiogroup, settings.label

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#two'); const group = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-segmented'); const radios = [...el.querySelectorAll('button[role="radio"]')]; return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'inline' && group.getAttribute('appearance') === 'track' && el.querySelector('[role="radiogroup"]').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Язык' && radios.length === 2 && radios[0].textContent.trim() === 'Русский' && radios[0].lang === 'ru' && radios[1].textContent.trim() === 'English' && radios[1].lang === 'en' && radios[0].getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && el.value === 'ru'; })()

probes.title: a press on English sends one change {value en, previous ru}; the page takes it: SF.language, lang and dir on <html>
a cancelled change leaves everything as it was: the value, the page's language and the switch's plate

steps.script: (window.__stop = (event) => { if (event.target.id === 'two') event.preventDefault(); }, window.addEventListener('change', window.__stop, true), document.querySelector('#two button[role="radio"][lang="en"]').click(), true)

probes.title: labels="code" shows the codes; each segment keeps the language's name as its accessible name

steps.check: (() => { const radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('#codes button[role="radio"]')]; return radios.map((b) => b.textContent.trim()).join(' ') === 'RU EN DE' && radios[2].getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Deutsch' && radios[2].lang === 'de'; })()

probes.title: the dated boolean compact draws as labels="code" and is noted once in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C134)

steps.check: (() => { const radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('#compact-alias button[role="radio"]')]; const notes = SF.deprecations.list().filter((note) => note.component === 'sf-language' && note.from === 'compact'); return radios.map((b) => b.textContent.trim()).join(' ') === 'RU EN DE' && radios[2].getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Deutsch' && notes.length === 1 && notes[0].to === 'labels="code"' && notes[0].remove_after === '2027-01-01'; })()

probes.title: five languages are the same button «RU ▾» (translate glyph) named «Язык: Русский» and a menu of radio rows: the name in itself, its name in the page's language beside it (C142 (3)), the C32 panel width, each row in its language
probes.covers: look menu, accessibility trigger name, icon translate

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#five'); const button = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-button button'); return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'menu' && button.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Язык: Русский' && button.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu' && el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-button').getAttribute('icon-start') === 'translate' && !el.querySelector('sf-segmented'); })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#five sf-menu-context [role="menuitemradio"]')]; const de = rows.find((row) => row.lang === 'de'); return rows.length === 5 && Math.round(document.querySelector('#five sf-menu-context .sf-context-menu').getBoundingClientRect().width) === 320 && de.querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-label').textContent.trim() === 'Deutsch' && de.querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-value').textContent.trim() === 'немецкий' && rows[0].getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && !rows[0].querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-value') && rows[1].querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-value').textContent.trim() === 'английский' && document.querySelector('#five sf-button button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; })()

document.documentElement.lang === 'de' && document.querySelector('#five sf-button button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Language: Deutsch' && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#five sf-button button')

probes.title: twelve languages open the menu with a search field; «нем», «German» and «de» each find Deutsch alone
probes.covers: look search, the menu's search, keywords

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#twelve'); const field = el.querySelector('.sf-context-menu-search-input'); return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'search' && field && document.activeElement === field && field.placeholder === 'Найти язык' && el.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitemradio"]').length === 12; })()

steps.script: (() => { const menu = document.querySelector('#twelve sf-menu-context'); const found = (query) => { menu.setQuery(query); return new Promise((done) => requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => done([...menu.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitemradio"]')].map((row) => row.lang).join(' ')), 60))); }; return (async () => [await found('нем'), await found('German'), await found('de'), await found('zz')].join('|'))(); })()

steps.check: document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#twelve sf-button button') && document.querySelector('#twelve sf-button button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'

probes.title: three languages open the menu (C142); Arabic is applied right to left: dir rtl on <html>, the change says so; Russian puts ltr back
a language with an href is followed, not applied, and remember keeps the code
one language draws nothing; mode inline keeps five languages in a switch

steps.check: (() => { const one = document.querySelector('#one'); const forced = document.querySelector('#forced'); return one.getAttribute('data-look') === 'none' && one.children.length === 0 && forced.getAttribute('data-look') === 'inline' && forced.querySelectorAll('button[role="radio"]').length === 5 && forced.look === 'inline'; })()

probes.title: items gives a language its own label; the list is read from the island

steps.check: (() => { const radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('#named button[role="radio"]')]; return radios.length === 2 && radios[0].textContent.trim() === 'Қазақ тілі' && radios[0].lang === 'kk' && document.querySelector('#named').value === 'ru'; })()

probes.title: in a form the element submits its code by name; a press changes it, reset brings back the written value
mode="inline": an arrow moves the focus and chooses nothing; Enter chooses the focused language (C142 (4))
a language without this page stays in the list, says «нет перевода — откроется главная» and goes to its main page (C142 (6))

steps.check: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('#missing sf-menu-context [role="menuitemradio"][lang="de"]'); return Boolean(row) && row.textContent.includes('нет перевода — откроется главная') && !document.querySelector('#missing [role="menuitemradio"][lang="en"]').textContent.includes('нет перевода'); })()

probes.title: two variants of a language show the region (PT-BR), Chinese its script (简体), one variant the language alone (PT); the menu names each in full (C142 (9))

steps.check: (() => { const shown = (id) => [...document.querySelectorAll(`#${id} .sf-language-code > span`)].filter((span) => getComputedStyle(span).visibility === 'visible').map((span) => span.textContent.trim()).join(); return shown('variants') === '繁體' && shown('lone') === 'PT' && document.querySelector('#variants sf-button button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Язык: 中文（繁體）'; })()

probes.title: mode="field" is a dropdown field with its label above; the element submits the code (C142 (8))

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#as-field'); const dd = el.querySelector('sf-dropdown'); return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'field' && dd && dd.getAttribute('label') === 'Язык письма' && new FormData(document.querySelector('#letter')).get('letter') === 'en'; })()

probes.title: SfLanguage.menuEntry: the app menu's «Язык» row, the current name its value, a submenu of the language rows at the panel width (C142 (7))

steps.script: (() => { const L = customElements.get('sf-language'); const entry = L.menuEntry({languages: 'ru en de', value: 'ru', page: 'ru'}); document.querySelector('#app').entries = [entry]; return JSON.stringify([entry.text, entry.value, entry.icon, entry.width, entry.submenu.map((row) => row.id + ':' + (row.value || '')).join(' '), L.codeOf('language:de')]); })()
